channel.title: After the First 48
channel.desc: When an unidentified woman is found dead outside a Tulsa home, detectives must sift through murky details to figure out who she is and what happened to her. What initially seems like a fatal car crash, turns into a homicide case upon further review. With the defendant being the lone witness to what transpired that night, prosecutors must rely on the evidence to find justice for the victim.
